verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a desktop robotics simulator with a GUI, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents a plugin-based GUI, CLI tools, headless mode and transport libraries, but nothing about a built-in AI assistant that tasks can be delegated to. Plugins and CLI tools are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
